records.text: Owens said retired Brigadier General Val Peterson had responsibility for training, readiness, administration and the Uniform Code of Military Justice for six major Army commands in Utah.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He's now retired as the Brigadier General, so he went beyond 10 more years, and he was responsible as a Brigadier General for training, readiness, administration, uniform code of military justice for six major army commands within the state of Utah.
